Name: Lighttrakker
Description: Rebecca Littlehale is a mutant with the ability to teleport to where ever she sees a light. She has little or no control over this power, so she wears sun glasses to keep herself in one place. She was discovered as a mutant when her sunglass where knocked off and she instantly teleported onto a bridge.
